subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Tris(acetonitrile)molybdenum tricarbonyl（fac-Mo(CO)₃(MeCN)₃）？
A. Octahedral
B. Trigonal prismatic
C. Trigonal planar
D. Linear
explanation: Octahedral. Covalent count: Mo (group 6) 6 e; 3 × CO (L) 6 e; 3 × MeCN (L) 6 e: 18 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry no charge and the complex is neutral, so the metal is Mo(0), d⁶; d⁶ + 12 e from the ligands = 18 e. A source of Mo(CO)₃: the acetonitriles are easily replaced.
